example.title: Tan three-storey apartment block no. 825 over garages
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: An early-1970s three-storey apartment block: tan stucco with raised vertical panels, plain aluminium windows, four white garage doors on the ground floor and a short drive. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Oceanfront Visitor Ctr.
